quotes.text: "date input should have a date value"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: After waitForDateTimePickerPanelShown resolves, checkABrowser queries DateTimePickerPanelPopupFrame on that returned panel, clicks a day cell in its document and waits for the panel to hide. It then directly checks that the content date input has a value; it does not assert a particular day. The one-line historical fix updates the internal frame ID. The older 250 ms workaround and unrelated HTML color-picker preference remain separate. Upstream engine bodies and a live picker run were not verified.
title: The form-picker helper uses the returned panel and its current frame ID
